reviews.text:
We visited because our dog had ingested something harmful. Since we had called ahead to inform them of the incident, they were able to begin treatment even before we finished filling out the initial consultation form.

Early treatment is crucial, so we were incredibly grateful that they started treatment without waiting for the paperwork to be completed.

Also, the nurses and veterinarians were very gentle with our dog, which put us at great peace of mind.

The clinic was also very close, less than a 5-minute walk from Yoyogi Park.

The staff were so kind!!

Thank you!
This is the veterinary clinic we use regularly. The doctor's explanations are thorough and easy to understand, which puts us at ease. The staff's service is also excellent.
This hospital is located right in front of Yoyogi Park. They also have a grooming room, so you can easily ask for simple grooming, nail clipping, anal gland expression, and other care.

I visited this clinic on the recommendation of a fellow dog walker, and I was very pleased with the doctor's precise treatment and thorough communication.

Although I'm switching clinics, I hope to continue receiving care here for many years to come.

The female staff member's service was extremely poor.

I went to the store because I needed to buy something urgently, but it seemed they had already closed the registers. She didn't answer my questions and seemed annoyed. I think staff members who close the registers and act annoyed even during business hours should be fired.

The doctor and nurses were very kind and patiently answered my amateur questions, which put me at ease.
The reception staff were also very pleasant.
It wasn't too crowded, the waiting room was bright, and I thought I'd like to continue coming here.

The doctor was kind and I felt at ease when I asked him for treatment. 
The receptionists and nurses were also very polite and kind.

I've been receiving their care since my dog ​​was a puppy.
They've performed various surgeries on him, including neutering and nasolacrimal duct irrigation.
The doctors and nurses are very kind and attentive, and my dog ​​is always excited when we go to the hospital.

I've been going to this veterinary clinic ever since I adopted my rescue toy poodle a year and a half ago.

I'm always so grateful that they carefully understand even my vague explanations and provide thorough examinations.

Thank you for your continued support.
I am very grateful to the kind and attentive person who answered my phone call, and to the clinic director for patiently answering even my smallest questions.

My 16-year-old grandpa dog is a handful and spoiled old man who barks and resists everything, but the staff are so kind and gentle with him, and they perform treatments and examinations in a way that doesn't put any stress on him, so I feel completely at ease leaving him in their care.
There are many animal hospitals in the area, but this one has the most solid knowledge and the best service. The doctor looks young, but he is very reliable.

This is a trustworthy animal hospital.

I am very grateful to Dr. Higuchi, who was in charge of my pet's care.
